title: Profile: Kanti Mardia. “From my school days, I had a passion for mathematics. I would have been a misfit in either medicine or engineering”
content:
Abstract
The Royal Statistical Society’s annual Mardia Prize – awarded in March 2025 to Eleni Elia – was founded by, and named after, Kanti Mardia to support the interdisciplinary workshops he considers so vital to scientific progress. Here, we celebrate the RSS fellow’s 90th birthday with a discussion of his career highlights
